newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen shares plunge at noon on crackdown talk.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen shares plunge at noon on crackdown talk.

text.p: Shenzhen's A and B share indices nosedived during the Wednesday morning session, hit by talk of further action by Beijing to crack down on speculative trading, brokers said.
The A share index tumbled 25.32 points or 5.94 percent to 401.13 on turnover of 3.8 billion yuan.
The B share index dived 6.09 points or 4.14 percent to 141.02 on turnover of HK$28 million.
"Widespread rumours on Beijing's imminent new crackdown measures triggered panic selling in A shares and the B shares followed suit," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said.
The rumours say Beijing will announce the punishment of several major domestic brokerages found to have conducted illicit stock trading, brokers said.
In May, the markets reacted sharply to rumours that Beijing would ban four of China's biggest securities houses from trading on their own accounts and would fine them for alleged trading misconduct.
"The A share losses were created in part by selling from banks whose equity position liquidation deadline is drawing near," an analyst at J&A Securities (H.K.) Ltd said.
The state banks are required to unwind their share positions within 10 sessions from last Friday to sqeeze the so-called "speculative bubble" out of the stock market.
"Sentiment is worsening with the rumours spreading and further losses are likely later this week," another analyst with a major Chinese brokerage said.
Technical charts tracking the A and B indices are also signalling more losses, brokers said.
On the B share market, Shenzhen Tellus Machinery was the worst performer, diving HK$0.30 to its 10 percent limit-down level at HK$2.68.
Tellus on Tuesday announced it had replaced all seven of its board directors to try to turn the firm around after it lost 187.55 million yuan for 1996.
On the A share market, building materials maker and property developer Shenzhen Universe fell 10 percent, its daily downward limit, to 17.72 yuan.
